Loss-of-function mutations in AIFM1 disrupt mitochondrial respiration and apoptosis regulation, leading to both MONDO:0010275 and severe X-linked mitochondrial encephalomyopathy.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of distinct pathogenic variants in AIFM1 with opposing functional consequences (e.g., one causing loss-of-function and the other gain-of-function) for each disease would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: rs123456789)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of AIFM1 in these distinct yet mechanistically related disorders could pave the way for developing targeted therapies that address the common downstream consequences of AIFM1 dysfunction, potentially benefiting patients with either condition.
